Date: 2026-11-14T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Throttlepoint: weekly ops delegation & QBR asks

Morning team — quick compact update for this week (wins / risks / immediate asks) ahead of the QBR prep window. Keeping this tight so we can move to owners and deadlines.

Wins
- Pilot readiness: Acme pilot model artifacts are validated and small-scale runs show 12% token-cost improvement vs baseline.
- Observability: New tracing hook landed in staging; end-to-end traces now capture cold-cache tail latency.

Risks / Signals
- Capacity squeeze: expected spike when Acme moves from alpha -> beta (projected +30% TPS for two weeks). If unmitigated, 95th p99 latency could degrade past SLO.
- SLA carve: Acme has requested an accelerated SLA for pilot; legal needs guidance on indemnity + data retention terms to finalize.

Immediate asks (owners & deadlines)
- Capacity mitigation: Markus to scope a short-lived burst pool and cost delta by EOD Thursday (owner: markus_klein).
- SLA decision: Laura to sign off on proposed carve (owner: laura_bennett) — decision by Friday COB so we can proceed with procurement.
- QBR artifact: I uploaded a compact QBR ask list with specific metrics and asks (attachment: QBR-ask-list.xlsx). Please review and add one line per owner in column B by Thursday.

Attachments: QBR-ask-list.xlsx, infra-runbook-v2.pdf (infra runbook contains the burst pool playbook).

If you want a quick 15-min sync today, I can run through the numbers — otherwise please update the sheet and call out blockers.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the summary and the attachment. Quick proposal to address the capacity squeeze:

- Temporary burst pool (2x mid-tier nodes) pinned to Acme pilot namespace for the first 2 weeks of beta. Estimated incremental cost: ~$5k/day (back-of-envelope).
- Fallback behavior: if p95 > 250ms for > 10m, automatically shift lower-priority routes to cached responses and signal CS.

I’ve attached the infra runbook excerpt (infra-runbook-v2.pdf) that documents the playbook and required ops steps. Next steps for me: produce a short cost-impact table and a rollback checklist by EOD Thursday.

Action items (tracked in the sheet):
- markus_klein: cost table + rollback checklist — due Thu EOD
- laura_bennett: SLA decision — due Fri COB
- vanessa_ortiz: customer note + HubSpot ticket — due Thu noon

If everyone is aligned I’ll start the capacity request flow and pre-stage images.

— Markus
Director, Infrastructure
